sentences.text: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for respondent No.2 jointly submit that the petitioner and respondent No.2-complainant, who married to one Ramachandra Krishna Nayari,
have amicably settled the dispute between themselves.

It is jointly submitted that petitioner No.1 is the mother of Sri Ramachandra Krishna Nayari while petitioner No.2 is her sister's husband and in view of the settlement arrived at between respondent No.2 and her husband i.e., accused No.1, the impugned proceedings qua the petitioners may also be quashed.
Joint submission is placed on record.
2. In view of the settlement arrived at between respondent No.2 and accused No.1, the impugned proceedings in C.C.No.1621/2023 pending on the file of the Court of II Addl.

Senior Civil Judge &
ACJM at Udupi, qua petitioners/accused Nos.2 and 3, are hereby quashed.
